prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the highway. Initial contact made with the claimant, who reports neck and back strain and is not represented by an attorney. Photos of both vehicles requested.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from the insured. Insured describes the other vehicle's turn signal as not active before the merge. Police report reference requested from the responding agency. Damage to the driver side rear quarter panel and passenger side mirror of the insured vehicle noted in the photo set.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted to review medical treatment status. Claimant reports ongoing stiffness in the neck and lower back, with pain worsening after long periods of sitting. Claimant has seen a primary care provider and has been advised to continue follow-up. Explained the claims process and that claimant may choose to consult an attorney at any time.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspection completed at the repair facility. Estimate reviewed for panel replacement and paint work on the rear door and quarter panel. Rental vehicle authorized for the insured for the expected repair period. Medical records authorization form sent to the claimant for signature.

Entry 5: Signed medical authorization received from the claimant. Records request sent to the treating provider. Liability assessment in progress based on the statements, photos and police report. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the injury component. Next action: follow up on records and reassess liability once the police report is received.
